navy-gold.use_for: board pack, weekly team brief; the default, matches the business-team deck
navy-gold.color_scheme: dark navy and off-white with antique gold and steel blue accents
navy-gold.typography: serif headers (Cambria) with tracked uppercase eyebrows, clean sans-serif body (Calibri)
navy-gold.background: alternating solid dark navy (cover, section) and warm off-white (content)
navy-gold.accent_elements: short gold rule above titles, gold-topped KPI cards, navy so-what band

editorial-cream.use_for: research note or market commentary sent to a wider audience
editorial-cream.color_scheme: warm cream and charcoal with rust eyebrows and ochre data accents
editorial-cream.typography: bold sans-serif headers (Arial) with italic emphasis, tracked uppercase eyebrows, sans-serif body
editorial-cream.background: solid warm cream (content) with charcoal cover and section slides
editorial-cream.accent_elements: thin rule under the eyebrow row, oversized hero numbers, charcoal so-what band

data-white.use_for: investment committee pack or analyst deep-dive with dense tables
data-white.color_scheme: clean white with near-black text, crimson accents and blue / amber data series
data-white.typography: bold geometric sans-serif headers (Calibri), compact sans-serif body, uppercase table headers
data-white.background: white content slides with a near-black cover and section slides
data-white.accent_elements: crimson top bar, crimson eyebrows, dark table headers, thin grey dividers

charcoal-amber.use_for: internal deal or strategy discussion shown on a screen; dark room, few words per slide
charcoal-amber.color_scheme: near-black charcoal throughout with amber accents and steel blue / amber data series
charcoal-amber.typography: bold sans-serif headers (Arial), monospace tracked labels (Consolas), sans-serif body
charcoal-amber.background: solid dark charcoal on every slide
charcoal-amber.accent_elements: amber rule and monospace eyebrows, raised charcoal panels, amber hero numbers

forest-cream.use_for: client-facing market overview or fund / owner update that should feel private-bank
forest-cream.color_scheme: deep forest green and warm cream with brass accents and blue / ochre data series
forest-cream.typography: serif headers (Georgia) with italic emphasis, tracked uppercase eyebrows, sans-serif body (Calibri)
forest-cream.background: alternating solid forest green (cover, section, statement) and warm cream (content)
forest-cream.accent_elements: brass rules, italic serif numerals, cream cards with brass top edge, forest so-what band
